criteria.title: Locate a bounds, lifetime or initialization contract violation in an isolated learner-owned program using existing T03/T16/T21/T32 artifacts.
criteria.task: Diagnose separate original bounds, initialization, post-free and post-successful-resize cases using integer generation histories before any native negative run. Identify the first invalid transition and the required caller precondition.
criteria.purpose: All memory faults are the same mechanism or same-address resize preserves aliases.

deliverables.D1: Prediction and causal explanation addressing: All memory faults are the same mechanism or same-address resize preserves aliases.
deliverables.D2: Diagnose separate original bounds, initialization, post-free and post-successful-resize cases using integer generation histories before any native negative run. Identify the first invalid transition and the required caller precondition.
